Keywords: instagram reels story carousel post visual photo aesthetic brand lifestyle
Audience: 18-35 year olds. Visual-first. Discovery-based. Consumer brands dominate.
Best Content: Reels (highest reach), Carousels (highest saves/shares), Stories (daily engagement), Single image (brand aesthetic)
Peak Times: Tuesday-Friday 9-11am and 6-9pm (local time). Reels: any time (algorithm-driven)
Caption Formula: Hook (first line stops the scroll) → Value/Story → Call to action → Hashtags (3-5 niche + 3-5 broad). Keep caption <125 chars before 'more' cutoff for full read.
Metrics: Reach, engagement rate (aim 3-6%), saves (best signal), shares, follower growth, story views, Reel plays
Ad Format: Reels Ads, Stories Ads (vertical video), Feed photo/carousel ads, Shopping ads

Keywords: facebook page group ads community b2b b2c older demographic reach paid
Audience: 25-55 year olds. Community-focused. Facebook Groups highly engaged. B2C and local businesses.
Best Content: Video (native video gets 3x reach), Link posts with strong preview image, Text posts in Groups, Events
Caption Formula: Story hook → Provide value/entertainment → Question to drive comments → Optional: link in caption (or first comment for reach)
Metrics: Reach, engagement rate (aim 1-3% for pages, 5-10% for groups), group growth, event RSVPs, video views
Ad Format: Facebook Feed ads, Stories ads, Marketplace ads, Video ads (strong performer), Lead gen ads

Keywords: linkedin b2b professional thought leadership executive networking lead gen content
Audience: 25-55 professionals. B2B buyers, executives, job seekers. Decision-makers in business.
Best Content: Text posts with personal story/insight (highest organic reach), Carousels (document posts), Native video, Polls
Posting Frequency: 3-5x/week. Daily for aggressive growth. Consistency > frequency.
Caption Formula: Bold first line (no 'see more' needed to get hook). Line breaks for readability. Personal angle. End with a question or CTA. 3-5 relevant hashtags.
Metrics: Impressions, engagement rate (aim 2-5%), profile views, connection growth, InMail open rate, DM replies (lead gen)
Ad Format: Sponsored Content, Message Ads (InMail), Lead Gen Forms (best for B2B lead capture), Conversation Ads

Keywords: twitter x tweets threads news real-time conversation hot takes trending engagement
Audience: 25-45. Tech-savvy. News-focused. Creators, journalists, builders, founders.
Best Content: Threads (education/opinion), Single tweets with hot takes, Polls, Quote tweets. Real-time is key.
Posting Frequency: 1-5x/day. Threads: 2-3x/week. Consistency matters more than volume.
Peak Times: Morning 8-10am and afternoon 2-5pm EST (global platform — engagement spreads throughout day)
Caption Formula: Single tweet: Hook + Opinion or Fact + CTA/question. Threads: Strong opener tweet → 3-10 value tweets → CTA close tweet. Use plain language.
Metrics: Impressions, engagement rate (aim 2-4%), replies, retweets, profile clicks, link clicks, follower growth
Ad Format: Promoted tweets, Promoted accounts, Twitter Cards, Video ads

Keywords: tiktok short video viral trends creator ugc organic reach entertainment younger
Audience: 16-30 primary. Growing to 30-45. Entertainment and discovery-first. Authenticity wins over polish.
Best Content: Original sound with trending audio, Educational/How-to (native to TikTok), Behind-the-scenes, Duets/Stitches. Raw > polished.
Posting Frequency: 1-3x/day for aggressive growth. Minimum 5x/week. Algorithm rewards consistency.
Peak Times: Any time — TikTok algorithm surfaces content on relevance, not recency. Test different times and check analytics.
Caption Formula: Hook in first 3 seconds (or lose them). On-screen text + voiceover for accessibility. Strong ending or loop. CTA in caption. 3-5 hashtags (mix niche and broad).
Metrics: Views, completion rate (aim 50%+), shares (viral signal), profile visits, followers gained per video, saves
Ad Format: In-Feed Ads (native video), TopView (first thing seen on open), Brand Takeover, Spark Ads (boost organic posts)

Keywords: youtube video SEO search tutorial review long form education vlog channel
Audience: All ages. Intent-driven (search-based) and discovery (suggested). Depth and value over virality.
Best Content: Tutorials/How-to, Product reviews/comparisons, Educational series, Vlogs, Interviews, Case studies. 8-15min sweet spot.
Posting Frequency: 2-3x/week for growth. 1x/week minimum. Consistency is critical.
Peak Times: Thursday-Saturday 2-4pm (upload earlier to index). Optimized for search — day matters less than SEO.
Caption Formula: Title: SEO keyword + click trigger. Description: full keyword-rich summary + timestamps + links. Tags: 10-15 relevant tags. Thumbnail: bold text + face/emotion.
Metrics: Views, watch time, CTR (aim 5-10%), subscriber growth, comments, video search rankings, revenue (if monetized)
Ad Format: Pre-roll ads (skippable/non-skippable), Bumper ads (6s), Sponsored Cards, YouTube Shopping, Masthead ads

Keywords: pinterest pins boards visual discovery shopping lifestyle recipe design e-commerce
Audience: 18-45. Predominantly female (60%). DIY, home, fashion, food, travel, weddings. High purchase intent.
Best Content: Vertical images (2:3 ratio — 1000x1500px), Step-by-step guides, Product pins with price, Infographics, Video pins
Posting Frequency: 5-10 pins/day. Use Tailwind for scheduling. Consistency is critical.
Peak Times: Saturday morning (8-11am) and evenings (8-11pm). Tuesday-Thursday also strong.

Metrics: Monthly views, saves (most important), outbound clicks, close-up rate, follower growth, Pinterest-driven web traffic
Ad Format: Promoted Pins, Shopping Ads, Collection Ads, Carousel Ads, Video Pins

Keywords: strategy content calendar analytics growth engagement community social media marketing
Audience: All audiences — depends on platform mix
Best Content: Content mix: 60% educational/value, 30% entertainment/storytelling, 10% promotional. Rule of thirds. Consistency > virality.
Posting Frequency: Minimum 3x/week on chosen platforms. Better to dominate 2 platforms than spread thin across 5.
Peak Times: Use platform-native analytics to find your peak times. What works on one platform rarely works directly on another.
Caption Formula: Content pillars: 3-5 themes that define your brand. Batch create content. Plan 2 weeks ahead. Leave room for real-time content.
Metrics: Follower growth rate, engagement rate, reach, conversion from social, share of voice, referral traffic
Ad Format: Organic first, then amplify winners with paid. Retarget engaged audiences. Use lookalike audiences from top engagers.
